question: To which revilers of sacred figures must the teaching never be given?
premises: The teaching must not be given to them
inference: The teaching must not be given to revilers of Shiva or slanderers of the Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may indicate the slandered figure or the context; relation is compressed
plain_english: O goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
